    assert sha(root/'forward-inputs'/row['path'])==row['sha256']

bound_paths=[report,project/'docs/plan/devforgeai-codex-rust-enforcement-design.md',root/'root-command-log-final.json',root/'regressions-final-03.txt',root/'builder-observations-03.jsonl',root/'legacy-observations-03.jsonl',root/'routing-observations.jsonl',root/'gap-trial-observations.json',root/'revision-final-independent-readback.json',root/'artifact-delta.json',root/'reviewer-repair-agent-log.json']
